title: General Available: Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28)
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28, version 28.0) is generally available. New SaaS customers get it automatically, and existing customers are notified by email when their update is ready. On-premises download packages are delayed and will follow soon.
key_points: BC28 is GA with platform 28.0.48222.0 and application 28.0.46665.48257 (W1)
New customers sign up on BC28 automatically; existing customers get email notices when updates are available
On-premises 28.0 packages are delayed but expected shortly
On-premises version 28.x is supported from Apr 1, 2026 to Oct 13, 2027 under the Modern Policy
The post links back to the BC25 change that gave more flexible update windows (5 months for major updates, with optional minor updates)

quotes.text: Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 wave 1 (BC28) is generally available.
quotes.why_it_matters: Marks the official release date and version number for the 2026 release wave 1

quotes.text: Major update: 30(60) days -> 5-month and Optional minor updates
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows significant change to update cadence for BC25 with longer intervals and flexibility
